Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:1.hebrew: הניחא למ"ד כו' - פלוגתא בפ"ק דגיטין (דף יב:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:1.english: This works out well according to the one who says, etc. - [This is] a dispute in the first chapter of Gittin (12b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:2.hebrew: זכות הוא לעבד - טובה היא אצלו שמתירו בקהל, וכיון דזכות הוא, איכא לתרוצי דמשעה שנכתב זוכה בשחרור, דלכי מטא שטר גט לידיה, נעשה בן חורין למפרע משעת חתימה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:2.english: It is an advantage for a slave - It is a benefit for him, for it permits him [to enter] into the congregation [of Israel]. And since it is an advantage, it is possible to answer that from the time it is written he acquires [his] emancipation, so that when the bill of manumission reaches his hand, he becomes a free man retroactively from the time of signing.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:3.hebrew: חוב הוא לעבד - חובתו הוא שיוצא מתחת רבו, כלומר הפסד הוא לו: שאם עבד כהן הוא, פוסלו מן התרומה; ואם של ישראל, אוסרו בשפחה כנענית, דזילא ליה ושכיחא ליה ופריצא ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:3.english: It is a liability for a slave - It is to his detriment that he leaves his master’s authority, that is to say, it is a loss for him: for if he is the slave of a priest, [manumission] disqualifies him from [eating] teruma; and if [he is the slave] of an Israelite, it forbids him [from cohabiting] with a Canaanite maidservant, who is inexpensive for him, readily available to him, and uninhibited with him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:4.hebrew: מאי איכא למימר - דהשתא ליכא למימר עדיו בחתומיו חבין לו, דאין חבין לאדם שלא בפניו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:12:4.english: What is there to say - For now one cannot say [that] its witnesses, with their signatures, act to his detriment, since one may not act to a person's detriment in his absence.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:14:1.hebrew: דא תהא למיקם - שטר זה יהיה לקום ולהיות בכל הכתוב בו, דדברי שכיב מרע ככתובין וכמסורין דמי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:14:1.english: This will be to stand - This document will stand and exist with respect to all that is written in it, for the words of a dying person are [considered] as written and as delivered.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:14:2.hebrew: מתנה - מתנת בריא, איזו היא? כל שכתוב בו כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:14:2.english: A gift - [This refers to] a gift of a healthy person; what is [it]? Any [deed] in which it is written, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:14:3.hebrew: מהיום ולאחר מיתה - גוף הקרקע קנוי לו מן היום, ואין לו עוד רשות למוכרה וליתנה ולהורישה, והפירות אינו אוכל כל ימי חייו אלא לאחר מיתה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:14:3.english: From today and after death - The principal of the land is acquired by him [the recipient] from today, and he [the giver] no longer has the right to sell it, give it away, or bequeath it; and the produce he [the recipient] does not consume all the days of his [the giver's] life, but rather after [his] death.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:15:1.hebrew: ואי לא לא קני - בתמיה. כל שכן דאם יהיב ליה גוף ופירות במעכשיו, דקני טפי; סתם מתנת שכיב מרע לא קניא לו אלא לאחר מיתה, דמחמת מיתה הוא מצווה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:15:1.english: And if not, he does not acquire [it] - [This is asked] in astonishment! All the more so, if he gives him [both] the principal and the produce with [the clause] "from now," he acquires [it] all the more! [Rather,] an unspecified gift of a person on his deathbed is acquired by him only after death, for he commands [it] because of [his impending] death.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:17:1.hebrew: הא אמר תנו נותנין - אמתני' פריך, דתלי טעמא בשאני אומר נמלך עליהם שלא לתנן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:17:1.english: But [if] he says, "Give," they give [them] - [The Gemara] raises a difficulty against the Mishnah, which makes the reason depend on [the concern], "I say he reconsidered regarding them, not to give them."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:18:1.hebrew: אפותיקאות - שעשה לו שדה אפותיקי למלוה על פה, שהיתה לו עליו מלוה ישנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:18:1.english: Apoteika'ot [deeds of designated repayment] - [Deeds stating] that he made a field an apoteiki [designated property for repayment] for him for a verbal loan, as he had an old loan against him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:18:2.hebrew: לא יחזיר - שמא כתבה לזה ולא מסר לו ולא זכה בקרקע, וחזר וכתב לאחר ומסר לו השטר וזכה בו, ובא לחזור בו מן השני ורוצה לתת לראשון, וחפץ שימסרו לו שטר זה שיוציאנה בבית דין, ונמצא זמן שטר של זה קודם לשטרו של שני, ויוציאנה מידו בדין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:18:2.english: He should not return [it] - Perhaps he wrote it for this [first person] and did not hand [it] over to him, so he did not acquire the land; and then he went and wrote [a deed] for another [person], and handed the deed over to him and he acquired it. And [now] he comes to retract from the second [person] and wants to give [it] to the first [person], and he desires that they hand over this deed to him so that he may produce it in court, and it will turn out that the date of this one's deed precedes the deed of the second [person], and he will take [the land] from his possession by law.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:1.english: [He] lost a bill of divorce - [Meaning] that he was an agent to deliver [it], and he lost it, and they found it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:2.hebrew: אמר אי סימנא - חשיבא לכו, אית לי בגויה סימנא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:2.english: He said: If a distinguishing mark - [is] considered [valid] by you, I have a distinguishing mark on it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:3.hebrew: ואי טביעות עין - חשיבא לכו, אית לי בגויה טביעות עינא. מכירו אני בכתב ידי הסופר והעדים, מדת ארכו ורחבו, כאדם המכיר את חבירו בטביעת עין שטבע בו ואין בו סימן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:3.english: And if visual recognition - [is considered valid] by you, I have visual recognition of it. I recognize it by the handwriting of the scribe and the witnesses, [and by] the measure of its length and its width, like a person who recognizes his fellow by a visual impression that is stamped in him, [even though] there is no distinguishing mark in it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:4.hebrew: וקסברי - רבנן סימנין דאורייתא, שלא אמרתי סימן מובהק והחזירוהו לי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:4.english: And they hold - The Rabbis [hold that] distinguishing marks [are effective] by Torah law, for I did not state a definitive distinguishing mark, yet they returned it to me.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:1:5.english: And specifically to a Torah scholar - For it is established for us regarding him that he does not alter his word [i.e., he does not lie].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:3:1.hebrew: ולא נתן עד תשרי - וכל זמן שלא נתן, היה לו לאכול ולמכור פירי נכסי מלוג שלה, שתקנו חכמים לבעל לאכול פירות של נכסי מלוג אשתו שנפלו לה לירושה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:3:1.english: And he did not give [it] until Tishrei - As long as he had not given [it], he had [the right] to consume and to sell the produce of her melog [usufruct] property, for the Sages instituted for a husband [the right] to consume the produce of his wife's melog property that fell to her as an inheritance.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:3:2.english: And sold [the] produce - Lawfully [as was his right].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:4:1.hebrew: שפיר - יש לה לטרוף כל מה שמכר משעת כתיבה, והא פלוגתא במסכת גיטין בפ' שני (דף יז:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:4:1.english: Well - She may repossess whatever he sold from the time of writing [the bill of divorce]; and this dispute is in tractate Gittin, in the second chapter (17b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:5:1.english: When did the bill of divorce come into your hand? - From the hand of your husband.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:7:1.english: When the document came into your hand - From the hand of the borrower originally.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:8:1.hebrew: אתי לוקח ותבע - אי אתיא למיטרף, מסיק אדעתיה לתבוע, "אייתי ראיה אימת מטא גיטא לידך בזמנא קמא":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:8:1.english: The purchaser comes and demands - If she comes to repossess [property], it occurs to him to demand: "Bring proof [as to] when the bill of divorce came into your hand the first time."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:9:1.hebrew: מקמי דידי - מקודם שמכר לי הלוה נכסיו, מטא שטר מיד לוה למלוה בראשונה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 19a:9:1.english: Before me - Before the borrower sold me his properties, the document came from the hand of the borrower to the lender originally.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:1:1.hebrew: אי סימנין דאורייתא - בגט נמי מהדרינן. ואי סימנין דרבנן — מה שמחזירין אבידה בסימן שאינו מובהק, מדרבנן משום דהפקר בית דין הפקר; אבל מדאורייתא צריך או עדים או סימן מובהק, וגט נמי דאיסור הוא, לא מהדרינן אלא בסימן מובהק:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:1:1.english: If distinguishing marks are [valid] by Torah law - we also return a bill of divorce [based on them]. And if distinguishing marks are [only valid] by rabbinic law — [then the fact] that we return a lost item based on a non-distinctive mark is by rabbinic law, because [of the principle that] what the court declares ownerless is ownerless [hefker beit din hefker]; however, by Torah law, one needs either witnesses or a distinctive mark, and for a bill of divorce as well, since it is a matter of [ritual] prohibition, we do not return [it] except based on a distinctive mark.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:1:2.hebrew: אבל איניש דעלמא לא - מפרש ר"ת דעם הארץ נמי אית ליה טביעות עינא, כדאמר בפ' גט פשוט (ב"ב דף קסח.): "האי מאן דבעי לקדושי איתתא לידבר עם הארץ בהדיה". והאי דלא מהדרינן ליה — משום דלא מהימן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:1:2.english: But an ordinary person, not - Rabbeinu Tam explains that an am ha'aretz [unlearned person] also has visual recognition, as it says in the chapter [entitled] Get Pashut (Bava Batra 168a): "One who wishes to betroth a woman should take an am ha'aretz with him." And the reason we do not return [it] to him is because he is not believed.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:3:1.hebrew: וליחוש דלמא כתב ליתן בניסן כו' - ואפילו לאביי דאמר "עדיו בחתומיו זכין לו", הכא גבי אשה חוב הוא לה. ואמתני' דדייקינן: "הא אמר תנו — נותנין", וכן אמתני' דהמביא גט ממדינת הים, לא פריך: "ניחוש שמא כתב ליתן בניסן כו'", כיון דעתה שבא לגרשה רואין שהזמן מוקדם, ויש קול שלא נמסר ביום שנכתב, ויזכרו לקוחות לומר: "אייתי ראיה אימת מטא גיטא לידך". אבל הכא, שהבעל מודה שממנה נפל וגירשה ביום הכתיבה, פריך: "וניחוש שמא יסברו לקוחות שאמרה אמת, ולא יאמרו בשעת טריפה 'אייתי ראייה אימת מטא גיטא לידך'". וא"ת: ואמאי לא פריך אמתני' דכותבין גט לאיש אע"פ שאין אשתו עמו — ליחוש שמא לא יתן עד שנה? וכי תימא: כיון דליכא ריעותא דנפילה, י"ל יום שנכתב נמסר, ואפי' נמסר נמי אחר זמן יש קול שלא נמסר ביום שנכתב, כי רואים בשעת קבלת הגט שהוא מוקדם, ויזכרו לקוחות לומר כשתטרף "אייתי ראיה" — דהא לעיל (בבא מציעא דף יב:) פריך גבי "כותבין שטר ללוה"! ויש לומר: דגבי "כותבין שטר ללוה" פריך שפיר, משום דמאן דיזיף בצנעא יזיף (ב"ב מב.), ויש לחוש שמא לאחר זמן ימסור לו בצנעא ויסברו לקוחות שנמסר לו משעת כתיבה; אבל גט דיהבי בפרהסיא — דצריך עדי מסירה אפילו לר"מ, דאין דבר שבערוה פחות משנים כדפירש ר"ת ורשב"ם בגיטין (ד. ד"ה דק"ל), ועוד דרגילות לגרש בפרהסיא לגלות שהיא פנויה — יש קול שנתגרשה אחר זמן כתיבה, ולא יטעו הלקוחות. אבל אכתי קשה: אמאי "כותבין גט לאיש כו'"? ניחוש שמא תזנה אחר הכתיבה, ויתן לה בצנעא כדי לחפות עליה! וי"ל: דמיד שנכתב הגט נותן לה, דלא מקדים איניש פורענות לנפשיה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:3:1.english: "But let us suspect that perhaps he wrote [it] to give in Nisan, etc." - And even according to Abaye, who says [that] "[the] witnesses [signed] on it acquire [the rights] for him" [from the time of signing], here regarding a woman it is a disadvantage to her [and therefore does not take effect until delivery]. And on our Mishnah, from which we infer [that] if he said, "Give [it]," we give [it to her], and likewise on the Mishnah of "One who brings a get from overseas," [the Gemara] does not challenge: "Let us suspect that perhaps he wrote [it] to give in Nisan, etc." — because now, when he comes to divorce her, [people] see that the date is predated, and there is public knowledge that it was not delivered on the day it was written, so the purchasers will remember to say [to her], "Bring proof of when the get reached your hand." However, here, where the husband admits that it fell from her and [that] he divorced her on the day of writing, [the Gemara] challenges: Let us suspect that perhaps the purchasers will think she is telling the truth, and will not say at the time of repossession, "Bring proof of when the get reached your hand." And if you ask: Why does [the Gemara] not challenge the Mishnah [stating] that "One may write a get for a husband even though his wife is not with him" — let us suspect that perhaps he will not give [it] until a year [later]? And if you say [that] since there is no impairment of having fallen, one can say [that] on the day it was written it was delivered, and even if it was delivered after some time there is public knowledge that it was not delivered on the day it was written because [people] see at the time of receiving the get that it is predated and the purchasers will remember to say when she comes to repossess, "Bring proof" — [that cannot be,] for above (Bava Metzia 12b) [the Gemara] does challenge regarding "One may write a loan document for a borrower"! And one can say that regarding "One may write a loan document for a borrower," [the Gemara] challenges well, because "whoever borrows, borrows in secret" (Bava Batra 42a), and there is reason to suspect that after some time he will hand it to him in secret, and the purchasers will think that it was handed to him from the time of writing. However, [with] a get, which is given in public — since it requires witnesses of delivery even according to Rabbi Meir, as "no matter of marital status [can be established] with fewer than two [witnesses]," as Rabbeinu Tam and Rashbam explained in Gittin (4a, s.v. de'kal), and furthermore because it is customary to divorce in public to make it known that she is unmarried — there is public knowledge that she was divorced after the time of writing, and the purchasers will not err. However, it is still difficult: Why "may one write a get for a husband, etc."? Let us suspect that perhaps she will commit adultery after the writing, and he will give [it] to her in secret in order to cover up for her! And one can say that as soon as the get is written, he gives [it] to her, for "a person does not bring misfortune upon himself prematurely."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:5:1.hebrew: אימת מטא גיטא לידך - בשאר גיטין לא אמרינן כן, דמסתמא ביום שנכתב נמסר; אבל זה דנפל, אתרע:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 19a:5:1.english: "When the bill of divorce came into your possession" - In [the case of] other bills of divorce we do not say this, for presumably it was delivered on the day that it was written; however, this one, which fell, is impaired.
